entities.summary: Bagsecg, also known as Bacgsecg, was a viking and a leader of the Great Army, which invaded England. According to the Anglo-Saxon Chronicle, Bagsecg and Healfdene were "heathen kings" and joint commanders of the Great Army that invaded the Kingdom of Wessex during the northern winter of 870/71.
